narration.purpose: DM message bodies only — the narration serif marks the fiction.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: separating the sheet drawer overlay from the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass go-button: Play on login, send in the composer.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c9a35c; color: #14120f; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9a35c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Panel-filled field with a quiet seam and brass focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1e1b16; color: #e8e2d5; border: 1px solid #3a352c; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; width: 100%; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 1px solid #c9a35c; }

components.name: Campaign Card
components.description: Full-width table row with a brass scroll mark and dim subtitle.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #1e1b16; border: 1px solid #2a2620; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; color: #e8e2d5; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card .ds-mark { color: #c9a35c; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-card small { color: #8d8577; display: block; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #3a352c; }

components.name: Segmented Mode Control
components.description: do / say / ooc pills; the active mode is the only brass fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 999px; color: #8d8577; background: #262219; font-size: 14px; border: none; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button.ds-on { background: #c9a35c; color: #14120f; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Bar chrome (back, sheet): quiet icon, brass when active.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn ds-on"><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M15.75 19.5 8.25 12l7.5-7.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { background: none; border: none; padding: 6px; border-radius: 8px; color: #e8e2d5; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn.ds-on { color: #c9a35c; }

components.name: DM Narration Message
components.description: No bubble: brass label + parchment serif block. The lack of a bubble is the point.
components.html:
DM
The lantern gutters as something moves between the headstones.
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: 92%; } .ds-msg .ds-who { font-size: 13px; color: #9fb37a; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-msg .ds-body { color: #e8e2d5; font-family: 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Player Bubble
components.description: Right-aligned Ink Blue bubble with a tail pointing at the speaker.
components.html:
Vess Anduriel
I check the grave for fresh digging.
components.css: .ds-msg-player { max-width: 92%; align-self: flex-end; } .ds-msg-player .ds-who { font-size: 13px; color: #c9a35c; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-msg-player .ds-body { background: #26303f; border-radius: 14px 14px 4px 14px; padding: 10px 12px; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Narration Mode Pills
components.description: On demand narration / Automatic narration in the settings flyout; one brief flash line on change, nothing persists.
components.css: .ds-narr { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-narr button { flex: 1; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 999px; color: #8d8577; background: #262219; font-size: 14px; border: none; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-narr button.ds-on { background: #c9a35c; color: #14120f; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Per-Line Play Button
components.description: Small brass ▶ beside the speaker's name on hearable replies; pause glyph while playing, hidden entirely in Off mode.
components.html: DM
components.css: .ds-play-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-play-row .ds-who { font-size: 13px; color: #9fb37a; font-weight: 700; } .ds-play { background: none; border: none; color: #c9a35c; padding: 2px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #c9a35c; }

components.name: Playback Bar
components.description: Appears above the composer only while a track plays: play/pause plus a bare seek slider; fades out at track end.
components.css: .ds-playbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #1e1b16; border-top: 1px solid #2a2620; padding: 10px 14px; } .ds-playbar button { background: none; border: none; color: #e8e2d5; cursor: pointer; } .ds-playbar input[type=range] { flex: 1; accent-color: #c9a35c; }

components.name: Error Flash
components.description: Errors surface as one centered Ember Red flash line above the composer, then fade — never a modal.
components.html: The adventure has not started yet.
components.css: #notice { margin: 0 12px 2px; text-align: center; font-size: 0.81rem; color: #b04a3a; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; } #notice.show { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: A player's phone at a candlelit table: the screen is a dark room, and the only light in it is warm and brass. Panels are one step off-black, text is parchment, and a single brass accent marks everything that matters. Density stays low and type stays 15–16px so it reads at arm's length in the dark. The one flourish is reserved for the fiction: DM narration is set in a serif, like a book being read aloud.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used sparingly, always meaning 'active' or 'go'
Two typefaces total: system sans for mechanics, a serif for narration (Lora default; Cormorant Garamond and IM Fell English selectable)
Flat surfaces, 1px borders, no shadows except the sheet drawer

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Brass is ≤10% of any screen. If two elements on a screen are gold, one of them is lying.

rules.name: The Serif Is The DM Rule
rules.body: The narration serif appears only on DM narration. Never for buttons or controls.

rules.name: The Drawer Casts the Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a new surface casts a shadow, it had better be an overlay.

dos: Do use Brass for exactly one 'active/go' element per state.
Do set DM narration in the narration serif and player content in system sans.
Do use Heroicons (outline) for UI chrome and RPG Awesome for game-flavored marks.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent or a cool background color.
Don't bubble the DM's messages — the plain serif block is the DM.
